I will do it close to what people around me do here in southern Hebei, because I only have 5 mu and I cannot gamble with the harvest. I have only farmed 3 years, so I start from the common local way and adjust a little. For wheat, I will use improved seed, put the base fertilizer down before sowing, and then chase more nitrogen at jointing. Wheat here eats fertilizer and water, and if I hold back too much, the heads stay small. I would rather spend a bit more on fertilizer than lose grain. For maize after wheat, I will also use hybrid seed, because the better hybrid seed usually gives steadier ears and my neighbors also use it. I have well irrigation, so I will not let the crop wait too long for water at key times. I will keep pesticide use to what is usually needed, not too many sprays, because every spray costs money, but I will not skip the main ones. On 5 mu, I still think carefully about cost, so I will use rotary tillage for convenience and speed, and I will aim for stable yield instead of chasing an extreme yield.
